classification: Analyst orderly-exit scenario, not a liquidation appraisal, management plan or guaranteed floor

challenge_record.basis: Stop before the unchanged downside requires new money in 2030; no conditional financing in this alternative.
challenge_record.challenge: Management may wait, funding may fail earlier, and orderly disposition may require time.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Liquidity forecast, committed funding, board capital allocation and contract termination conditions.

challenge_record.basis: Explicit analyst haircuts to forecast assets; cash/securities excluded because already credited in cutoff equity bridge; customer financing excluded consistently with zero recovery reference.
challenge_record.challenge: No buyer bid or asset appraisal. Specialized inventory/launch assets and restricted cash may be unrecoverable; proceeds may be delayed.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Independent appraisal, collateral/transfer restrictions, receivable collections and credible bids; stress PPE and inventory haircuts.

challenge_record.value: Full listed operating liabilities plus 100 million closure cost
challenge_record.basis: Assume full customer advance refunds and ordinary liability settlement, remaining noncurrent operating lease settlement, tax liability payment; separate financial claims already deducted in equity bridge.
challenge_record.challenge: No legal claim-priority analysis; full refunds may be too severe or cancellation damages may be larger. Closure cost is a placeholder scenario.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Contract-specific termination, employee, environmental, tax and landlord estimates; stress closure cost 50-250 million.

challenge_record.basis: Reference deducts operating cash at cutoff; this reserve is released once when operations cease.
challenge_record.challenge: Reserve might be consumed during disposition; never add all year-end cash again.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Detailed exit cash-flow schedule and restricted/pledged balance review.
